executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from urllib.parse import urljoin,urlparse
import json,hashlib,re,requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
ROOT=Path.cwd();R='reports/research/510300_enterprise_working_capital_source_v1';OUT=ROOT/R
def now():return datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def save_new(name,obj):
 p=OUT/name;assert not p.exists(),'已存在不覆盖：'+name
 p.write_text(json.dumps(obj,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
def readj(rel):return json.loads((ROOT/rel).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
proto=readj(R+'/protocol.json')
extra=['reports/research/510300_fiscal_receivables_company_bridge_v1/result.json','reports/research/510300_historical_cash_quality_causes_v1/result.json','reports/research/510300_historical_index_earnings_population_v1/result.json']
extras=[{'path':rel,'sha256':sha(ROOT/rel),'fully_read_actual_result':readj(rel)} for rel in extra]
assert all(not z['all_target_alias_contexts'] for z in proto['prior_use_full_reads'][:8])
qualification={'completed_at':now(),'finite_original_files_full_read':17,'extra_direct_old_results_full_read':3,'original_contexts_preserved_in':'protocol.json','existing_target_mentions':'只有当前E84提案/导航及名称，没有发现本范围同企业家原资金周转字段的旧金融输入。','extra_company_cashflow_boundary':'旧财报现金质量/三家公司回款及整体盈利研究是财报/公司/行业重构，没有采用央行企业家资金周转原扩散问卷。旧T11日期代理失败不重开。','same_original_field_same_financial_use_found_in_finite_scope':False,'does_not_claim_all_repo_exhaustive':True,'old_bank_demand_and_approval_frozen':True,'direct_extra_results':extras,'financial_model_not_registered':True}
save_new('有限旧用途实际资格.json',qualification)
base='reports/research/510300_bankers_loan_demand_source_qualification_v1/sources/'
cats=[base+'catalog_root.html']+[base+f'catalog_page_{j:02d}.html' for j in range(2,6)]
catrows=[];found={}
for rel in cats:
 p=ROOT/rel;soup=BeautifulSoup(p.read_bytes().decode('utf-8'),'html.parser')
 catrows.append({'path':rel,'sha256':sha(p),'original_current_catalog_reused':True})
 for a in soup.find_all('a',href=True):
  title=a.get_text(' ',strip=True);m=re.fullmatch(r'(20\d{2})年(?:第)?([一二三四1234])季度企业家问卷调查报告',re.sub(r'\s+','',title))
  if not m:continue
  year=int(m.group(1));q={'一':1,'二':2,'三':3,'四':4}.get(m.group(2),int(m.group(2)) if m.group(2).isdigit() else None);key=f'{year}Q{q}'
  if key not in proto['target_quarters']:continue
  url=urljoin('https://camlmac.pbc.gov.cn',a['href'])
  if key in found:assert found[key]['release_url']==url,'目录同季不同原链接：'+key
  found[key]={'quarter':key,'title':title,'release_url':url,'original_catalog':rel}
assert set(found)==set(proto['target_quarters']) and len(found)==29,'原完整29目录未齐'
targets=[found[k] for k in proto['target_quarters']]
save_new('全部29原企业家问卷目录映射.json',{'registered_at':now(),'catalog_GETs_this_stage':0,'existing_original_catalogs':catrows,'targets':targets})
SOURCE=OUT/'sources';SOURCE.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
target=targets[0];url=target['release_url'];path=SOURCE/('release_'+target['quarter']+'.html');assert not path.exists()
with (OUT/'实际取件调用账本.jsonl').open('a',encoding='utf-8') as f:f.write(json.dumps({'kind':'release','quarter':target['quarter'],'url':url,'request_started_at':now()},ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
resp=requests.get(url,timeout=30);raw=resp.content;path.write_bytes(raw)
receipt={'kind':'release','quarter':target['quarter'],'requested_url':url,'final_url':resp.url,'status_code':resp.status_code,'local_received_at':now(),'path':str(path.relative_to(ROOT)).replace('\\','/'),'bytes':len(raw),'sha256':sha(path),'content_type':resp.headers.get('Content-Type')}
save_new('首个原企业家发布页实际回执.json',receipt);resp.raise_for_status()
soup=BeautifulSoup(raw.decode('utf-8'),'html.parser')
print(json.dumps({'全部原目录':29,'原目录新GET':0,'首次原企业家发布页':receipt,'实际meta':[str(z) for z in soup.find_all('meta')],'页面正文开头':soup.get_text(' ',strip=True)[:4500],'原PDF附件':[{'href':urljoin(resp.url,z['href']),'text':z.get_text(' ',strip=True)} for z in soup.find_all('a',href=True) if '.pdf' in z['href'].lower()]},ensure_ascii=False))
